=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh:43 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The evidence collector hardcodes `--kind autofix_failure`, so other report kinds select unrelated successful jobs or produce an evidence-unavailable stub instead of the relevant failure logs.
  WHY: For non-autofix reports, the evidence bundle can omit the actual error signature; severity disagreement: two reviewers marked this major and one marked it blocker.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh:57-61 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Untrusted log content is placed inside the evidence fences without neutralizing literal begin/end delimiters contained in the log.
  WHY: A log containing the closing delimiter can terminate the prompt’s untrusted-data fence and place subsequent log text outside it.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh:197-222; scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:1213; scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:842-844 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Autofix failure evidence copied from runtime log tails bypasses credential redaction before being included in the dispatch payload and diagnosis prompt.
  WHY: Basic authorization headers or encoded PATs in those logs can be preserved as plain text and exposed to the next model.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh:35-44 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The log redaction path does not strip ANSI escape sequences before matching credential patterns.
  WHY: A credential split by escape sequences can evade the Basic-header pattern and remain in the evidence bundle.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:335-345; scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:188-196 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The heal scope marker advertises wildcard paths that `entry_matches` treats as literal prefixes, so new test files and changelog fragments are rejected as out of scope.
  WHY: The isolated editor cannot transfer those sanctioned outputs, so implementation is refused and the issue is latched `ai:needs-human`.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:77-80, 109-112 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Docker container-name filter uses `^` and `$` as if Docker’s `name=` filter supported regular expressions.
  WHY: The filter uses substring matching, so the survival check may fail to detect a container that remains running; severity disagreement: one reviewer marked this major and one marked it blocker.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2819-2823; scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:280-287 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `verify_run` rejects phase-failure runs whose conclusion is null while the source workflow is still in progress.
  WHY: The intake rejects phase reports before collecting jobs or logs, so clarify, plan, and implement phase-failure reports cannot proceed.
- tests/test_heal_isolated_editor.py:46 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts the old `write_guard.sh` source expression, but `implement.yml` uses a nested fallback expression.
  WHY: The exact-string assertion fails in CI.
- tests/test_plan_clarify_blocked_output.py:249 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The clarify staging-list assertion expects the old list and omits the newly added heal scripts.
  WHY: The exact-string assertion fails in CI.
- tests/test_auto_decisions.py:184 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The implement staging-list assertion expects the old list and omits the newly added heal scripts.
  WHY: The exact-string assertion fails in CI.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:1207-1209 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The fake GitHub client strips comment responses to fields that omit the `user` object and `author_association`, regardless of the requested projection.
  WHY: Provenance verification needs those fields to authenticate phase-report comments, so the affected reports are rejected.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:1231-1236; 1245-1251 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The run-details mock handler exits on an ID-only lookup miss before trying the existing path-keyed fixture.
  WHY: Tests with run details keyed by `repos/<repo>/actions/runs/<id>` receive a mock 404 and are rejected during run lookup.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:1383-1384 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The refusal-marker fixture author is `pipeline`, but the mock authenticated user is `workflow-bot`.
  WHY: The reporter requires the marker author to match the authenticated account, so it dispatches instead of recognizing the refusal.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:1888 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The successful-review fallback test fixture sets the run conclusion to `success`, which the provenance check’s `REPORTABLE_CONCLUSIONS` rejects.
  WHY: The test is rejected as `not_failed` before it reaches the successful-job fallback logic.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:1882-1891 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The successful-review fallback fixture does not associate its run with the PR through a `pull_requests` entry or trusted PR failure comment.
  WHY: Provenance rejects the run before the successful-review fallback can be exercised.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:809 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The required `tests-promote-stall-and-review` CI job failed, but the provided log tail does not identify a specific failing assertion or step tied to the diff.
  WHY: The required lint aggregate needs this job to succeed, leaving the PR blocked.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:4504 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The test calls `.group()` on a regex match that is `None`.
  WHY: The test crashes before completing and contributes to the failures in `tests-heal-plan-and-validation`.
- scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh:8-18 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The refusal function silences failures from `gh issue comment` and `gh issue edit` and exits successfully.
  WHY: A failed comment or label write can leave no durable refusal marker, allowing the reporter to dispatch another heal.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:233-240, 280-287 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Intake fetches each run once for provenance and again for verification instead of reusing the cached run JSON.
  WHY: Each report makes redundant run-detail API calls and increases shared GitHub API quota use; severity disagreement: one reviewer marked this nit and the others marked it major.
- scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh:11-22 | severity=high | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The refusal function posts the comment before adding the label, but the reporter may process the label event before the comment is visible.
  WHY: The reporter may fail to find the refusal marker and dispatch another heal.
- scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh:39-43 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The scope file in `${RUNNER_TEMP}` can be overwritten after preflight because its read-only mode does not prevent a later step with write access to the directory from replacing it.
  WHY: The scope enforced at commit time may differ from the scope verified at preflight time.
- scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh:46-55 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `heal_isolated_implement.sh` reads the validator from the original support directory rather than the trusted support copy.
  WHY: A modified `validate_changed_files_syntax.sh` in the original support directory can be used in the validator container.
- scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh:50-55 | severity=high | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The source `.codex-workflow-src/scripts` directory remains writable after the trusted copy is created.
  WHY: Later steps can modify the source, which may be re-staged on a re-dispatch despite the current run using the immutable copy.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:56 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Resolving the editor prompt with `realpath` can follow a symlink to a file outside `${RUNTIME_DIR}` before mounting it into the container.
  WHY: A caller-controlled prompt path can expose an unintended runner-readable file to the container.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:1564-1579 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The base64-fragment slice in `redact_known_secrets` can produce `None` for a short encoding, then raise a `TypeError` when its length is checked.
  WHY: The redaction subprocess can crash and leave the intake with no evidence.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:1541-1547 | severity=high | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `extraheader` redaction pattern can leave a Bearer token after consuming only the first two whitespace-separated tokens.
  WHY: The subsequent Basic-header pattern does not catch a remaining Bearer credential.
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:184-189 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup path reports `reason=remove_permission_repaired` after `rm -rf` succeeds without checking whether the original filesystem problem was resolved.
  WHY: The misleading fingerprint can cause semantically different failures to share a fingerprint.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:67-78, 100 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Validator failures with exit codes 124–127 are treated as syntax errors and sent to the repair editor.
  WHY: A validator timeout or Docker failure can trigger futile editor retries and be reported with the wrong failure reason.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:33-37 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A failed Docker image build exits without logging actionable build diagnostics.
  WHY: Operators see a silent prepare-phase failure with no useful reason.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh:12-16 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: If the issue GraphQL call fails, the evidence script writes a stub and exits successfully, and callers do not distinguish the stub from a real evidence bundle.
  WHY: Clarify and plan can receive an unavailable-evidence placeholder as if it were actual evidence.
